name: duat-case-study
description: Case study: DUAT, my own ancient-Egyptian board-game product and its Next.js platform. Sales site, playable Senet and Tjau demo with a card-playing rollout AI, online matches, cash-on-delivery orders and an owner dashboard. Two games, one box

paragraphs: Two board games of ancient Egypt in one box, and a website where you can play them before you buy.
ℹ️ Case study. DUAT is my own commercial product, and its source code is private, so it is not included here. Every screenshot below is a real capture of the running app.

DUAT (دوات) is a physical board-game box sold in Egypt. It holds Senet, which Egyptians played from the First Dynasty, and Tjau, the "twenty squares", plus 8 Heka cards: a modern, optional twist that can change a match. Its web platform has three jobs:
features: Sell the box. An Arabic-first landing page (English too) that tells the story and shows what is in the box. The order form is cash on delivery.
Let people play first. A free demo of both games against the computer (3 levels), with two people on one device, or online with a friend. It uses the same boards, pieces and cards as the printed set.
Senet with 4 rule sets (basic, seven-piece Old Kingdom challenge, sixth throw, full challenge)
Tjau on the Egyptian board (16-square route) and the Board of Ur (14), with Babylon-tablet and extra-throw variants
Computer opponent at 3 levels. Medium and Hard decide on cards by running full-match rollouts (see below)

requirements.text: An e-mail sign-in unlocks more: codes are hashed, expire in 15 minutes, allow 5 attempts and are rate-limited.
